products.name: PERi-Ketchup
products.description: Everything you'd expect from a classic ketchup with an extra hit of PERi-PERi (African Bird's Eye Chillies). Fire up your favourite burgers, pies and sangas, or add a big squeeze on the side for some seriously spicy chip-dipping.

products.name: PERi-PERi Sauce Medium - 250ml
products.description: This is our gateway sauce: a good dollop of PERi-PERi (African Bird's Eye Chilli) with spices. For a while, it will be enough. But soon you'll want them all. Just go with it.

products.name: PERi-PERi Sauce Mild - 250ml
products.description: Even we have a mild side, but this is cutting it fine. Expect full, feisty flavour. With this blend of PERi-PERi (African Bird's Eye Chilli), garlic, lemon and spice, expect to fall head-over-meals.

products.name: PERi-PERi Sauce Hot - 250ml
products.description: If you're after a blast of heat, you've come to the right sauce. Bursting with PERi-PERi (African Bird's Eye Chilli), a kick of garlic and lemon, this is how hardcore PERi-PERi fans get caught in the heat of the moment.

products.name: PERi-PERi Sauce XX Hot - 250ml
products.description: We salute you. With eyes streaming and mouth burning, you'll fall for fire that doesn't flinch from flavour. Balanced with PERi-PERi (African Bird's Eye Chilli), lemon, onion, garlic and spices, you will be coming back for more.

products.name: PERi-PERi Sauce Garlic - 250ml
products.description: Garlic is many things but it's not subtle, just like this sauce! A blend of African Bird's Eye Chilli, spices, a hint of lemon and a generous kick of garlic, it will fill any first date with flavour and garlicky goodness! Pour this on both your plates and you can thank us later.

products.name: PERinaise Mild - 265g
products.description: The creaminess of mayonnaise, the warmth of PERi-PERi spices. A match made in flavour heaven. Dip it in chips, spread it on a sandwich, drizzle it on a salad, or even have it on a spoon. Whatever you fancy, flavour up with PERinaise.

products.name: PERinaise Hot - 265g
products.description: The taste of fiery perfection. Use it as a slightly spicy dip for chips, tortillas and crisps, or to give a creamy bite to sandwiches and salads. Out of things to have it on? Just have it on a spoon. Whatever you fancy, flavour up with PERinaise.

products.name: PERi PERi Salt - 50g
products.description: A little blue tin of goodness that contains our famous PERi-PERi salt you know and love from our Restaurants.

products.name: Sweet Chilli Jam
products.description: Welcome to the sweet (& spicy) life! Our Chilli Jam is jam-packed with tangy tomatoes and PERi-PERi, it's warm and sweet with a tingle of heat.

products.name: Malaria Bracelet (Small)
products.description: Buy and wear one of our Nandos Fighting Malaria bracelets and know you are making a difference! Two lives are protected from malaria through on the ground spraying programs in Mozambique with each bracelet sale. The best bit is we have partnered with a social enterprise to make them, so each bracelet is also giving a local South African woman a way to support her family. Note: design may vary from image, but variety is the spice of life, right?
